findings: `learner.overview.text` foregrounds unresolved analyses of 沒’s construction before explaining the character’s common reading and meaning, making this first-reading layer needlessly difficult. Lead with 没 as the simplified form of 沒, commonly read méi, “not have,” and leave the competing construction accounts to the detailed explanation. Cite the simplified relationship and current meaning.

`summary.text` presents the proposed sound-based loan for méi “not have” without making clear that other accounts in the dossier dispute this origin. Qualify it as a contested proposal and briefly acknowledge the alternatives, supported by E10, E11, and X-bf72d15468da578e34d0.

`meaning_history.senses[1].text` describes “end” or “exhausted” as an extension without identifying that semantic development as a commentator’s interpretation. Attribute and qualify the proposed extension, citing X-44e9cecadeb00637461c and X-4815c8ede58506961b1d.
